revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY23-25 revenue CAGR was ~0.8%, so growth is modestly above that on volume recovery plus ~2-3% pricing, fading to near GDP/inflation.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: FY2025 margin was 40.2% (9,846/24,510); a slight improvement is assumed, in line with the FY23-25 trend (37.7%, 40.1%, 40.2%).

tax_rate.source: Assumption: 21% federal plus state taxes. Damodaran's railroad effective rate is 17.0%, and I used a higher marginal rate to be conservative.

da_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: FY2025 D&A was 10.06% of revenue (2,465/24,510); FY23-25 range 9.6-10.1%.

capex_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: FY2025 capex was 15.5% of revenue (3,791/24,510); FY23-25 average about 14.8%.

wacc.source: CAPM: rf 4.86% (US 10Y, 2026-11-06, Treasury) + relevered beta 0.99 x ERP 4.46% (Damodaran US, 2026-02-16) = 9.3% cost of equity. Beta is Damodaran's railroad unlevered beta 0.814 relevered at the industry D/E of 0.278 (UNP market cap not available). Pre-tax cost of debt 4.73% (Damodaran), 3.7% after tax. Weights 78%/22%. Result is 8.1%, rounded to 8.0%.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: long-run nominal US growth, below the 4.86% risk-free rate.

net_debt.source: financial_statements derived net_debt = total debt 31,814 - cash 1,266 - short-term investments 0 (acc. 0000100885-26-000037). Leases excluded.

diluted_shares.source: Weighted average diluted shares, 595,900,000 (acc. 0000100885-26-000037), in millions.
